_about: THE ONE LIST of document kinds (order 14, planner 25 Nov 19:15 item 1). Every place that names a kind reads it through app/kind_list.py: the router that sorts uploads (document_kinds.json holds only its cues), the engine's table (kind_review_table.json holds only what each kind is reviewed with), the paper-kind reading, the sentence nouns and the kind picker. Each kind belongs to ONE review FAMILY. A kind that is not scored keeps its unscored behaviour (Automatic does not send it): the family says how a kind is laid out and read, never that it is scored. `routed`: the sorter has cues for it. `code_decided`: the paper-kind reading may decide it by itself. `cover_decided`: the title-block reader (document_kind) may name it from a document's number, title or cover. `picker_needs_switch`: the picker offers it only with PAPER_KIND_FIRST_ENABLED (as before). Names are the app's own; no outside list is imported (CFIHOS names are used only where the code already had them: none yet). Equipment types (relief valve, pump ...) are a different dimension: they sub-divide the datasheet family and live in equipment_taxonomy.json. Upload ROLES (contractor submittal, company standard ...) are another: what part a file plays, never what kind it is.
